paper: FLAG-TRADER: Fusion LLM-Agent with Gradient-based Reinforcement Learning for Financial Trading
headline_mechanism: FLAG-TRADER fuses a semantic market-state encoder with separate actor and critic heads, then updates the policy online from trading rewards using clipped proximal policy optimization.

source_anchors.claim: The prompt directs buying undervalued stocks, selling overvalued or high-risk stocks, minimizing transaction costs, and aligning with momentum.
Structured market state is encoded into a Buy/Hold/Sell action distribution through a policy head.
A separate value head estimates expected return while sharing the state representation.
Policy and value parameters update online from replayed experience, with PPO clipping used to limit policy divergence.

preserved_elements: semantic fusion of valuation, historical trend, momentum, and risk state
three-action Buy/Hold/Sell latent policy represented by expected signed action
separate linear actor and critic heads over one shared state
monthly online reward-gradient updates using only previously realized outcomes
paper learning rate, clipping coefficient, and maximum gradient norm
persistent action-memory smoothing to reduce policy turnover
approximated_elements: cross-sectional JKP ranks replace textual single-asset market and account prompts
a fixed finance-semantic weight vector replaces frozen SmolLM2 representations
linear actor and ridge critic replace trainable LLM, policy MLP, and value MLP heads
a deterministic advantage gradient with clipped parameter movement replaces sampled PPO likelihood ratios
continuous expected signed action replaces sampled Buy/Hold/Sell orders
invented_elements: the four JKP state features and their semantic prior weights
60-month replay window and 24-month minimum training history
ridge penalty for the value head
portfolio_adapter: Expected signed action is ranked within the frozen monthly top-1,000 universe and mapped to value-weighted long/short deciles; 10 bp one-way cost is primary.
claim_boundary: This is a researcher-authored FLAG-TRADER-inspired actor-critic policy, not the unreleased SmolLM2/PPO checkpoint, single-asset action trajectory, or a reproduction of the paper's reported returns.
